_comment: The names a site's machines and volumes are kept under on the
hypervisor, after the site's own name. The storage driver's token and
the sweeper's are confined by them: the contractor tells the hypervisor
what to grant from the Go generated from this file, and OpenTofu makes
the pools and points the driver at the storage from the same file. If
the two drifted, a token would be confined to a pool with no machines
in it, or the driver pointed at a storage it has no right to.
